**2.0 Minutes of the Executive Committee Meeting – 2026-02-07**

Venue: Secretariat Hall, Gusau
Time: 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM
Chairperson: Amina Bello, Coordinator
Secretary: Dr. T. Okonkwo
Present: 11 members (quorum 7)

**2.1 Opening and Confirmation of Previous Minutes**

The minutes of the meeting of 2026-01-19 were read and adopted. Matters arising were minimal; the Coordinator noted that the input fair logistics are progressing well.

**2.2 Coordinator’s Report**

The Coordinator, Amina Bello, presented a brief report on the state of cooperative affairs. She confirmed that the Cooperative registry records her as coordinator of Zamfara Green Cooperative Society, a position she has held since 2024. The registry entry was reviewed and is current as of this meeting.
